import re
import sys
from copy import copy
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "sales_data.xlsx"
wb = load_workbook(path)
name = next((s for s in wb.sheetnames if "sales" in s.lower()), None)
ws = wb[name] if name else wb.active
L = get_column_letter


def norm(v):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", str(v).lower())


# Locate the header row: the first few rows containing the most populated cells
header_row = 1
best = -1
for r in range(1, min(ws.max_row, 8) + 1):
    count = sum(1 for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)
                if ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value not in (None, ""))
    if count > best:
        best, header_row = count, r

headers = {c: ws.cell(row=header_row, column=c).value
           for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)
           if ws.cell(row=header_row, column=c).value not in (None, "")}

print("Sheet:", ws.title)
print("Header row:", header_row)
print("Columns:", headers)


def first_col(*patterns):
    for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
        n = norm(ws.cell(row=header_row, column=c).value or "")
        if n and any(p in n for p in patterns):
            return c
    return None


if any("margin" in norm(h) for h in headers.values()):
    print("Profit margin column already present; no change made.")
    wb.close()
    sys.exit(0)

rev_col = first_col("revenue", "sales")
if rev_col is None:
    wb.close()
    sys.exit("No revenue/sales column found; cannot compute margin.")
profit_col = first_col("profit", "income", "earnings")
cost_col = first_col("cost", "cogs")
if profit_col is None and cost_col is None:
    wb.close()
    sys.exit("Need a profit or cost column to compute margin.")

new_col = max(headers) + 1
new_letter = L(new_col)
header_cell = ws.cell(row=header_row, column=new_col, value="Profit Margin (%)")
header_cell.font = Font(bold=True)
try:
    src = ws.cell(row=header_row, column=1)
    header_cell.fill = copy(src.fill)
    header_cell.border = copy(src.border)
except Exception:
    pass

last_row = header_row
for r in range(header_row + 1, ws.max_row + 1):
    if isinstance(ws.cell(row=r, column=rev_col).value, (int, float)):
        last_row = r

written = 0
for r in range(header_row + 1, last_row + 1):
    if profit_col is not None:
        expr = '=IFERROR({}{}/{}{},"")'.format(L(profit_col), r, L(rev_col), r)
        basis = "profit / revenue"
    else:
        expr = '=IFERROR(({}{}-{}{})/{}{},"")'.format(
            L(rev_col), r, L(cost_col), r, L(rev_col), r)
        basis = "(revenue - cost) / revenue"
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=new_col, value=expr)
    cell.number_format = "0.0%"
    written += 1

ws.column_dimensions[new_letter].width = 16
wb.save(path)
print("Added column {} ({}: 'Profit Margin (%)')".format(new_letter, new_letter + str(header_row)))
print("Basis:", basis)
print("Rows written:", written)
wb.close()
